thread:
ashwin: quick heads-up — the new `orca-mini-v2` onboarding smoke failed schema lint. CI reports missing defaults and tokenizer length mismatch. pinging for quick triage.
maria: @ashwin saw the CI job, can you paste the lint output? or did the deploy-bot drop logs here?
ashwin: copied from `config-lint` job:
```
ERROR model/config.json: missing required field `sequence_defaults.max_length`
WARN model/tokenizer.json: vocab_size=50256 but tokenizer.model.vocab_size=50258 -> potential off-by-one padding
ERROR model/weights.json: uri points to gs://redwood-models/orca-mini-v2/weights/v1/ -> 404 on HEAD
```
nina: :eyes: okay weight URI 404 is probably the upload that failed last night. I can re-run the upload job but won't be online until 20m. someone else can hotfix the manifest in the meantime?
maria: I can open a small patch to add sensible defaults so schema lint passes (follow-up: we'll still need real weights). propose adding `sequence_defaults.max_length: 2048` and explicit `pad_token_id: 0`.
john: @maria please go ahead with the defaults PR, but leave a TODO comment pointing to the real weight URI. I'll follow up to retry the gs upload and update `weights.json` once it's available.
ashwin: thanks. for the tokenizer mismatch — we saw this with Mosaic models before: tokenizer artifact includes added special tokens. Quick workaround is to add `tokenizer.override_vocab_size: 50258` in model config so serving gatekeeper accepts it. we should also add a check in schema lint to treat small vocab_size diffs as WARN not ERROR.
maria: drafting PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/328 (WIP) — will add `sequence_defaults` + `tokenizer.override_vocab_size` and an explanatory comment. cc @john @nina
devbot: CI triggered for PR #328 — config-lint starting (queue position 2)
sre-bot: gatekeeper note: onboarding won't move to staging until `weights.json` URI HEAD succeeds and `auth: public_read` is confirmed on the bucket. marking as blocked.
john: re: bucket ACL — internal ops changed default in the new GCS pipeline, I'll coordinate with infra to make the object public_read for this upload. expected ETA 45m.
ashwin: action items: (1) @maria open PR with defaults + override (2) @john retry upload + update weights.json with final URI (3) @nina re-run upload job if john needs a hand. we'll re-run full smoke once weights HEADs OK. thanks all :thumbsup:
maria: PR pushed as draft, awaiting quick review. small code snippet in PR for the defaults:
```
  "sequence_defaults": {
    "max_length": 2048,
    "pad_token_id": 0
  },
  "tokenizer": {
    "override_vocab_size": 50258
  }
```
nina: noted — I'll schedule upload retry and tag infra if it fails. setting a reminder in the thread for 45m.
ashwin: perfect. tagging @oncall in case CI queue backpressure shows up during the rollout. will circle back when smoke passes or if we hit unexpected blockers.
